chapters.text_fil: Sa lupain ng Bohol may isang higanteng nagngangalang Arogo na umibig nang buong puso sa isang mortal na babae na si Aloya. Nang mamatay si Aloya umiyak si Arogo nang walang tigil at ang kanyang malalaking luha ay nahulog sa lupa ng Bohol at naging daan-daang bilugang burol na kapag tag-araw ay nagiging kayumanggi tulad ng tsokolate.
chapters.text_eng: In the land of Bohol there was a giant named Arogo who fell deeply in love with a mortal woman named Aloya. When Aloya died Arogo cried endlessly and his giant tears fell on the ground of Bohol becoming hundreds of rounded hills that turn brown like chocolate during summer.
